quests.title: Flip an empty row
quests.ask: Every cell of this row is empty. Flip them all, so each one ends with a gem.
quests.nudge: What should happen on a cell that has nothing on it?

quests.title: Flip a full row
quests.ask: Every cell of this row holds a gem. Flip them all, so the row ends empty.
quests.nudge: After the robot picks a gem, the cell is empty. Should it then put one back?

quests.title: Flip a mixed row
quests.ask: Some cells have a gem and some don't. After the flip, the full cells are empty and the empty cells are full.
quests.nudge: Each cell needs exactly one of two things done to it, never both.
